To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the PInSoRos dataset is a rich dataset of child child and human child interactions, that is suitable for data driven approaches to the study of social interactions; 2) a simple and effective way of acquiring this data is by engaging children in free play interactions; 3) the data can be used as a benchmark for the evaluation of social behaviour generation in child robot interaction; and 4) a simple baseline for social behaviour generation is to learn from the dataset.

the PInSoRobots dataset is a novel, open and large scale dataset of children social interactions, designed to support data driven research methodologies, and that the dataset comprises 45+hours of hand coded recordings, including annotations of social constructs and fully calibrated video recordings.
the PInSoRo dataset is a novel open dataset of child child and robot child interaction that can be used to explore the dynamics and the evolution of social interactions between children and robots.

the study of social interaction in children, with an emphasis on data driven approaches.
the development of a novel methodology for data driven research in child child and child child robot interaction, and we hope that the resulting dataset will be a valuable resource for the community.
the study of child child social dynamics and the development of a data driven methodology for the study and synthesis of child child social interactions.
